component.name: CardVertical
component.description: A vertical course card (image-top layout): a thumbnail, an optional ProgressBar under it (stack sm), the serif title (h3) and a metadata row (Inline gap sm) with optional duration, a Certified marker and a Completed marker. Status is derived from progress (ADR-025): omitted → not started (no bar), 0–99 → in progress (bar), ≥100 → completed (full bar + Completed marker). Two sizes: sm (fixed size.card.min.sm width, 3:2 thumbnail) for the saved-courses carousel, lg (fills its grid cell, min size.card.min.lg, 4:5 thumbnail) for the catalog grid. Single flat-prop component. For thumbnail-left lists use CardHorizontal; for generic surfaces use Card.

when: Showing courses in a catalog grid (size lg)
Showing saved or started courses in a horizontal carousel (size sm)

patterns.name: catalog-grid
patterns.description: Catalog grid of large cards; the grid tracks use size.card.min.lg as their minimum so cards never shrink below it.

patterns.name: saved-courses-carousel
patterns.description: Horizontally scrolling row of small fixed-width cards.
patterns.tree: ScrollArea(orientation=horizontal) > Inline(gap=md, wrap=false, align=start) > [CardVertical(size=sm, title, duration, progress?), ...]

antiPatterns.scenario: Passing a status or completed flag
antiPatterns.reason: Lifecycle is derived from progress (ADR-025); a separate flag allows impossible combinations.
antiPatterns.alternative: Pass progress={100} for a completed course and omit progress for a course not yet started.

antiPatterns.scenario: Packing certification or completion into duration, e.g. duration="12 Hours · Certified"
antiPatterns.reason: One prop per datum; the component renders the markers and their spacing.
antiPatterns.alternative: Pass duration="12 Hours" certified; pass progress={100} for Completed.

antiPatterns.scenario: Mixing sm and lg cards, or CardVertical with CardHorizontal or Card, in one row or grid
antiPatterns.reason: Different thumbnail ratios and widths break the visual rhythm.
antiPatterns.alternative: Use one size per section: sm in carousels, lg in grids.

antiPatterns.scenario: Placing CardVertical in a section whose heading is not an h2
antiPatterns.reason: The title always renders as an h3, so any other parent level skips or inverts the outline.
antiPatterns.alternative: Put cards inside a section headed by an h2.

antiPatterns.scenario: Colouring the title, metadata or marker icons via inline style or a color prop on Icon
antiPatterns.reason: Heading/Text own their colour; marker icons take color.icon.subtle from the .marker svg rule in the CSS Module.

purpose.sm: Saved-courses carousel: fixed width size.card.min.sm, 3:2 thumbnail.
purpose.lg: Catalog grid: fills its cell (min size.card.min.lg), 4:5 thumbnail.

states.description: progress omitted: no ProgressBar, no Completed marker.
progress 0–99: ProgressBar under the thumbnail, labelled by the title.
progress ≥ 100: full ProgressBar plus a check + 'Completed' marker in the metadata row.
thumbnailSrc omitted: Image renders its placeholder glyph.
No duration, not certified, not completed: the metadata row is not rendered.

ariaAttributes: role=article on the root, aria-labelledby → the title Heading's id (useId); role, children and aria-labelledby are omitted from the props type
thumbnailAlt defaults to empty (decorative) since the title names the card
